title: CIMR Neuromuscular Research Biobank
official: Center for Inherited Muscle Research Neuromuscular Research Biobank
summary: The purpose of this research repository is to collect, store, and share with other researchers any tissues that subjects with all types of neuromuscular disease are willing to donate. These samples will be stored at Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) and will be used for future research with this population.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Willing and able to give informed consent
* Positive diagnosis or suspected diagnosis of neuromuscular disease, or
* Family history of neuromuscular disease, or
* Healthy volunteer
* Age Neonates-75

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwilling to sign consent
